name: verify_caller
description: Verify that the caller belongs to the store before sharing ANY account information. Call it right after the caller confirms the store name. First call it without phone_last4 (caller ID may verify automatically); if it answers missing_factor, ask for the last 4 digits of the store's registered phone and call it again with them.

customer_code.description: The 5-digit customer code confirmed with lookup_customer, digits only.

phone_last4.description: Last 4 digits of the store's registered phone, exactly as the caller said them, digits only. Omit on the first attempt.
